Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2, the low-|n| semimetal regime; the hole side of the D = 0 line ends at −1.27) is a preview only. `sdh_onset` on run 6 returns the 7.1 T tone **censored at the record edge** (0.3 T), and the sub-1 T leg was a 50 mT grid that under-samples a 7 T tone below ~0.85 T — so the onset is not measured. `landau-fan` step 1: a censored carrying tone → pin the onset with a cheap low-field extension before the long fan, because on a uniform-1/B fan **B_lo is the expensive lever**: at Δ(1/B) = 0.009 T⁻¹, B_lo = 0.7 / 0.8 / 1.0 T costs 146 / 125 / 100 rows (≈ 5.7 / 5.0 / 4.1 h).
